schedules.repeat: Repeat the full call after resetting and poisoning the cache and workspace.
schedules.tokenwise: One token per call, including the 4096-token case.
schedules.irregular_tail: Append the remaining suffix, clipping each declared chunk at the case length.

confirmation.prompt: A rectangle has a perimeter of 30 meters and a width of 5 meters. Explain how to find its length and area.

policies.accuracy: Unchanged decoder-layer-v1 whole-layer and isolated-operation gates; exact Hugging Face agreement is not required.
policies.invariance: All 16 stored intermediates and both active KV prefixes must equal the candidate's own full-call bytes on the same hardware and build. Candidate bytes may differ from configuration 20.
policies.selection: Fast: validated measured winner per exact workload and reuse mode. Deterministic: a compatible arithmetic family across schedules; no independent phase winners unless cross-phase invariance passes. Unmeasured cells fall back to the declared baseline.
policies.timing: Four paired blocks, ten warmups and ten observations per arm, balanced order, same-run self-pair calibration, all valid observations retained. A gain requires all four ratios below one and a reduction exceeding max(5%, self-pair deviation).
policies.scope: One Qwen2.5-0.5B decoder layer on Apple Metal. Historical full-model accuracy failures remain separate; no full-model or cross-device determinism claim.

counters.description: Measures the time during which shader instructions are attempted to be processed as a percentage of peak shader execution pipeline performance. If the instruction throughput limiter is low, you can push more ALU and non-ALU instructions from the sub-blocks that are not fully limited. As an example if the instruction throughput limiter is less than 100%, but 100% F16 limited but less than 100% limited by F32, Integer and Complex or Integer and Conditional, then there is an opportunity to push ALU instructions from these ALU sub-blocks to execute in parallel
counters.name: Instruction Throughput Limiter

counters.description: Measures the time during which GPU’s last level cache is attempting to service read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance
counters.name: Last Level Cache Limiter
